# Install the latest Go release (>= 1.26) for linux/amd64, and verify the
# downloaded archive against the checksum published on go.dev.
ARG GO_VERSION=1.27.4
ARG GO_SHA256=7226736c2339719cda28fbf3a54d71aa63bcefe376e98cef00034268dab24840
RUN curl -fsSL "https://go.dev/dl/go${GO_VERSION}.linux-amd64.tar.gz" -o /tmp/go.tar.gz \
    && echo "${GO_SHA256}  /tmp/go.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c - \
    && rm -rf /usr/local/go \
    && tar -C /usr/local -xzf /tmp/go.tar.gz \
    && rm -f /tmp/go.tar.gz

# Install yt-dlp's official Linux-compatible zipapp release. python3 is
# installed above because this release uses Python on Linux.
RUN curl -fL "https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/releases/latest/download/yt-dlp" \
    -o /usr/local/bin/yt-dlp \
    && chmod 0755 /usr/local/bin/yt-dlp

# Install Deno system-wide so it is available to the railway SSH user too.
RUN curl -fsSL https://deno.land/install.sh -o /tmp/deno-install.sh \
    && sh /tmp/deno-install.sh \
    && rm -f /tmp/deno-install.sh \
    && test -x /usr/local/bin/deno

# Install ngrok (same v3 Linux amd64 package used by the original project).
RUN curl -fsSL \
    https://bin.equinox.io/c/bNyj1mQVY4c/ngrok-v3-stable-linux-amd64.zip \
    -o /tmp/ngrok.zip \
    && unzip /tmp/ngrok.zip -d /usr/local/bin \
    && chmod 0755 /usr/local/bin/ngrok \
    && rm -f /tmp/ngrok.zip

# Configure SSH while retaining the original project's railway login.
RUN printf '%s\n' \
    'Port 22' \
    'PermitRootLogin no' \
    'PasswordAuthentication yes' \
    'KbdInteractiveAuthentication no' \
    'PubkeyAuthentication yes' \
    'UsePAM yes' \
    'AllowUsers railway' \
    'AuthorizedKeysFile .ssh/authorized_keys' \
    > /etc/ssh/sshd_config

COPY start.sh /start.sh
RUN sed -i 's/\r$//' /start.sh && chmod 0755 /start.sh

EXPOSE 22

# Do not add USER railway here: start.sh needs root to initialize sshd.
CMD ["/bin/bash", "/start.sh"]

#!/bin/bash
set -Eeuo pipefail

printf '%s\n' '================================' 'Starting Railway SSH VPS' '================================'

# This entrypoint must run as root so it can set the account password
# and start the OpenSSH daemon.
if [[ "$(id -u)" -ne 0 ]]; then
    echo "ERROR: start.sh must run as root. Remove any USER railway directive from the Dockerfile."
    exit 1
fi

: "${NGROK_TOKEN:?ERROR: NGROK_TOKEN is missing}"
: "${SSH_PASSWORD:?ERROR: SSH_PASSWORD is missing}"

# Set the SSH password for the railway account.
printf 'railway:%s\n' "$SSH_PASSWORD" | chpasswd

# Optional SSH public-key authentication.
if [[ -n "${SSH_PUBLIC_KEY:-}" ]]; then
    install -d -o railway -g railway -m 0700 /home/railway/.ssh
    printf '%s\n' "$SSH_PUBLIC_KEY" > /home/railway/.ssh/authorized_keys
    chown railway:railway /home/railway/.ssh/authorized_keys
    chmod 0600 /home/railway/.ssh/authorized_keys
    echo "SSH public key authentication enabled."
fi

# Confirm sudo access is configured for the SSH user.
if ! visudo -c >/dev/null; then
    echo "ERROR: sudoers configuration is invalid."
    exit 1
fi

ssh-keygen -A
/usr/sbin/sshd -t

ngrok config add-authtoken "$NGROK_TOKEN"
/usr/sbin/sshd

printf '%s\n' \
    '================================' \
    'SSH server started successfully' \
    'Username: railway' \
    'Password authentication enabled' \
    '================================'

exec ngrok tcp 22 --log=stdout
